# Rewriter cases for scripts/rewrite-oracle/main.go, which writes rewrite-oracle.tsv. Vendored
# verbatim from protowire-java's pxf-runtime/src/test/resources/rewrite/cases.txt (3cdb31a), so
# both ports replay the same rows; keep the two in sync. The documents and
# operations are protowire-go v1.17.0's rewriter tests (rewrite_test.go, node_edit_test.go and the
# rewrite_keyed tests). Each case: === name, doc <quoted>, then one operation per line, its
# arguments quoted. Values and entries are PXF text, parsed with ParseTolerant.
=== set-scalar-preserves
doc "# heading comment\n\nserver {\n\thost = \"prod\"   # primary\n\tport = 8080     # keep me\n}\n"
set "server.port" "9090"
=== set-preserves-separator
doc "labels {\n  \"team\":   \"core\"\n}\n"
set "labels.team" "\"infra\""
=== set-inserts-multiline
doc "server {\n\thost = \"h\"\n}\n"
set "server.port" "8080"
=== set-inserts-inline
doc "inline { a = 1 }\n"
set "inline.b" "2"
=== set-inserts-empty-inline
doc "empty {}\n"
set "empty.a" "true"
=== set-appends-top
doc "a = 1"
set "b" "\"x\""
=== set-creates-chain
doc "server {\n  host = \"h\"\n}\n"
set "server.tls.min_version" "\"1.3\""
=== set-map-form
doc "labels {\n  \"team\": \"core\"\n}\n"
set "labels.env" "\"prod\""
=== set-multiline-tabs
doc "server {\n\ttags = [\"a\"]\n}\n"
set "server.tags" "[\"x\", \"y\"]"
=== remove-keeps-leading-comments
doc "# section\n# about a\na = 1   # trailing\nb = 2\n"
remove "a"
=== remove-block
doc "a = 1\nserver {\n  host = \"h\"\n}\nb = 2\n"
remove "server"
=== remove-inline
doc "inline { a = 1 b = 2 }\n"
remove "inline.a"
=== remove-trailing-block-comment
doc "x = 1 /* gone */\ny = 2\n"
remove "x"
=== remove-multiline-block-comment
doc "x = 1 /* spans\nlines */\ny = 2\n"
remove "x"
=== set-nested-badval
doc "xs = [1]\n"
set "xs" "[\"a\", $]"
set "m" "{ k = }"
=== errors
doc "server {\n  host = \"h\"\n}\nport = 1\n"
remove "nope"
set "server" "1"
set "port.sub" "1"
set "" "1"
set "a" "<nil>"
=== new-invalid
doc "port ="
=== conflict
doc "server {\n  host = \"h\"\n}\n"
remove "server"
set "server.host" "\"x\""
=== same-path-last-wins
doc "a = 1\n"
set "a" "2"
set "a" "3"
=== corpus/config.pxf
doc "@type demo.v1.Config\n\n# Server section \u2014 hand-aligned assignments, mixed indentation, the\n# kind of file goed settings writes must not reflow.\nserver {\n\thost = \"prod.example.com\"   # primary\n\tport = 8080\n\ttimeout    =   30s\n\n\ttls {\n\t  enabled = true\n\t  ciphers = [\n\t    \"AES128\",\n\t    \"AES256\",\n\t  ]\n\t}\n}\n\n/* block comment\n   spanning lines */\nlabels {\n  \"team\":        \"core\"\n  \"cost.center\": 42\n}\n\nweights = [0.25, 0.50, 1e3]\nwindow  = 2024-01-15T10:30:00Z\nblob    = b\"aGVsbG8=\"\nmode    = FAST\nempty {}\ninline { a = 1 }\n"
corpus
=== corpus/settings.pxf
doc "# goed editor settings \u2014 hand-written, comments everywhere\n\ntheme = \"gruvbox-dark\" // switch back to light in summer\nfont_size = 13\ntab_width = 4\n\n# Custom keymap. Order matters to the reader, not the machine.\nkeymap {\n  leader = \",\"\n  save   = \"ctrl+s\"\n\n  # chords\n  split_vertical = \"ctrl+w v\"\n}\n\nrecent = [\n  \"~/src/main.go\",\n  \"~/notes.md\"\n]\nflush = null\nretry = -3\nratio = 0.5\n"
corpus
=== chain-document-step
doc "server {\n    host = \"h\"\n}\n"
set "server.tls.min_version" "\"1.3\""
=== multiline-document-step
doc "server {\n    tags = [\"a\"]\n}\n"
set "server.tags" "[\"x\", \"y\"]"
=== replace-specific-sibling
doc "children {\n    a { type = \"Button\"  text = \"@one\" }\n    b { type = \"Button\"  text = \"@two\" }\n}\n"
replace "value:text#1" "\"@changed\""
=== replace-reindents
doc "server {\n    tags = [\"a\"]\n}\n"
replace "value:tags#0" "[\"x\", \"y\"]"
=== replace-last-wins
doc "a = 1\n"
replace "value:a#0" "2"
replace "value:a#0" "3"
=== replace-errors
doc "a = 1\n"
replace "<nil>" "1"
replace "value:a#0" "<nil>"
replace "value:a#0" "$"
replace "<unspanned>" "1"
=== setspan-splice
doc "a = 1\n"
setspan "4" "5" "42"
=== setspan-out-of-range
doc "a = 1\n"
setspan "-1" "2" "x"
setspan "3" "2" "x"
setspan "0" "999" "x"
=== append-sibling-indent
doc "server {\n    host = \"h\"\n}\n"
append "block:server#0" "port = 8080"
=== append-block-node
doc "children {\n    a { type = \"Button\" }\n}\n"
append "block:children#0" "b { type = \"Label\" }"
=== append-document-step
doc "root {\n    children {\n        greeting {\n            type = \"Label\"\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
append "block:children#0" "button { type = \"Button\" }"
=== append-empty-block-step
doc "root {\n    sub {\n        x = 1\n    }\n    children {\n    }\n}\n"
append "block:children#0" "button { type = \"Button\" }"
=== append-empty-inline
doc "children { }\n"
append "block:children#0" "a { type = \"Button\" }"
=== append-inline
doc "inline { a = 1 }\n"
append "block:inline#0" "b = 2"
=== append-map-form
doc "labels {\n  \"team\": \"core\"\n}\n"
append "block:labels#0" "env: \"prod\""
=== append-accumulate
doc "server {\n  host = \"h\"\n}\n"
append "block:server#0" "port = 1"
append "block:server#0" "debug = true"
=== append-empty-multiline
doc "server {\n}\n"
append "block:server#0" "port = 8080"
=== append-errors
doc "server {\n}\n"
append "<nil>" "a = 1"
append "block:server#0" "<nil>"
append "block:server#0" "a = $"
append "<unspanned>" "a = 1"
=== append-map-key-spelling
doc "labels { \"team\": \"core\" }\n"
append "block:labels#0" "404: \"int\""
append "block:labels#0" "\"123\": \"str\""
append "block:labels#0" "\"my key\": \"q\""
append "block:labels#0" "\"team\": \"again\""
=== setkeyed-replaces

=== anon-mv-comments-1
doc "f = [\n  { k = \"a\" }, # after a\n  // second\n  { k = \"b\" }, # after b\n  { k = \"c\" } # after c\n]\n"
keyedby "f" "k"
move "f" "c" "a"
=== anon-mv-comments-2
doc "f = [\n  { k = \"a\" }, # after a\n  // second\n  { k = \"b\" }, # after b\n  { k = \"c\" } # after c\n]\n"
keyedby "f" "k"
move "f" "a" "b"
=== anon-mv-comments-3
doc "f = [\n  { k = \"a\" }, # after a\n  // second\n  { k = \"b\" }, # after b\n  { k = \"c\" } # after c\n]\n"
keyedby "f" "k"
move "f" "c" ""
=== anon-mv-inline
doc "f = [\n  { k = \"a\" }, { k = \"b\" },\n  { k = \"c\" } # after c\n]\n"
keyedby "f" "k"
move "f" "c" "b"
=== anon-mv-other-binding
doc "f = [\n  { k = \"a\" },\n  { k = \"b\" },\n  { k = \"c\" }\n]\nf = [\n  { k = \"d\" }\n]\n"
keyedby "f" "k"
move "f" "a" "d"
=== anon-mv-past-list
doc "f = [\n  { k = \"a\" }\n]\nf = [\n  { k = \"c\" },\n  { k = \"d\" }\n]\n"
keyedby "f" "k"
move "f" "a" "d"
=== anon-comments-matrix
doc ""
matrix
=== nested-badval-0
doc "a = 1\n"
set "a" "{ x = }"
replace "value:a#0" "{ x = }"
=== nested-badval-1
doc "a = 1\n"
set "a" "{ b { x = } }"
replace "value:a#0" "{ b { x = } }"
=== nested-badval-2
doc "a = 1\n"
set "a" "{ b { c { x = } } }"
replace "value:a#0" "{ b { c { x = } } }"
=== nested-badval-3
doc "a = 1\n"
set "a" "[{ m: { b { x = } } }]"
replace "value:a#0" "[{ m: { b { x = } } }]"
# Added by protowire-rust (not in protowire-java's copy), for what no protowire-go test reaches:
# the overlap check at its one-byte boundary, the reparse safety net, and SetKeyed creating an
# element in the last of two bindings.
=== overlap-by-one-byte
doc "a = 123\n"
setspan "4" "6" "9"
setspan "5" "7" "8"
=== adjacent-spans
doc "a = 123\n"
setspan "4" "5" "9"
setspan "5" "6" "8"
=== reparse-refuses
doc "a = 1\n"
setspan "4" "5" "}"
=== setkeyed-creates-in-last-binding
doc "children {\n  a {\n    x = 1\n  }\n}\nchildren {\n  b {\n    x = 2\n  }\n}\n"
setkeyed "children" "c" "x" "3"
